description: This file defines the PkgSdk class, a specialized SDK class for handling Debian package management within a build system, including methods for copying directories, populating sysroots, and managing package installation and configuration.

classes.name: PkgSdk
classes.description: A subclass of Sdk, tailored for managing Debian packages in a specific SDK setup, with methods to handle directory copying, sysroot population, and installation sequences.

methods.name: __init__(self, d, manifest_dir=None)
methods.description: Constructor initializing paths, manifests, and package managers based on the provided data dictionary and optional manifest directory.

methods.name: _copy_apt_dir_to(self, dst_dir)
methods.description: Copies the 'apt' configuration directory from a staging directory to a specified destination.

methods.name: _populate_sysroot(self, pm, manifest)
methods.description: Populates the sysroot with packages specified in the given manifest, updating package managers accordingly.

methods.name: _populate(self)
methods.description: Performs the full SDK population process, including handling pre/post commands, installing target and native SDK packages, copying configuration files, and cleaning up.
